Weapons.Name: Ghost Orb
Weapons.Rule: Effects caused by this weapon's Status rule are removed at the start of next round's End Phase instead of this round's End Phase.

Rules:
When you activate this Feature, remove 1 enemy Battalion from each Feature on this Dropsite, then remove 1 enemy Battalion from anywhere on this Dropsite.
When a Ship carrying this Feature attacks, you may have one of its weapons gain Status for that attack.
